name: Days payables outstanding
description: Trade payables at the period end divided by credit purchases of the period, times the days in the period.
sign: Days; higher = the business takes longer to pay suppliers.

period.semantics: payables at the period end; credit purchases over from..to; days = days in from..to inclusive

freshness.note: computed only from a projection that has caught up with the ledger

basis: Purchase basis: credit purchases are the bill value (incl. GST, like the payable) credited to trade payables by journals that move no cash, net of debit notes; each journal counts once. Proxy: when no such journal exists in the period but payables are open, cost of sales plus other expenses for the period is used and the result says PROXY.
